title: Moody Rainy Street Portrait
description: A solitary figure under a street lamp on a rain-slick road at night, with reflections, drifting mist and deep blue shadows. It is a quiet, atmospheric portrait for storytelling, book covers and wallpapers.
promptText: Moody cinematic portrait of a woman in a long black raincoat standing alone under a street lamp on a rain-soaked road at night, hood down, rain falling softly, looking over her shoulder at the camera. Warm sodium-yellow lamp light from above and behind, rim light on her hair and shoulders, deep blue shadows, wet asphalt reflecting the light, thin mist in the distance. 50mm lens, aperture f/1.8, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, cinematic teal and amber colour grade, fine grain. Vertical 2:3 composition, medium full shot, subject on the left third, empty dark road stretching to the right.
imageAlt: Woman in a black raincoat under a street lamp on a rainy night road
visualNotes: Mood comes from contrast: a single warm lamp against a field of cool blue. The rain adds texture to the light itself, catching it in streaks, while the empty road gives the subject somewhere to look and creates narrative tension.

customize.lighting: Add 'a faint cool blue light from a distant window' to introduce a second colour source, or remove the mist for a crisper, more graphic look.
customize.camera: A 35mm lens makes the street feel larger; a 85mm lens compresses the lamp and subject for a more intimate look.
customize.background: A narrow alley, a bus stop shelter or a bridge underpass all keep the same atmosphere. Keep at least one light source in the frame.
customize.wardrobe: A trench coat, hooded parka or umbrella changes how the figure reads. Strong colour accents, like a red scarf, stand out beautifully against the blue.
customize.mood: Turn 'looking over her shoulder' into 'walking away from the camera' for a more mysterious feel.
customize.composition: For a thriller-style poster, place the figure small at the bottom and leave the top half as dark, misty space.
customize.aspectRatio: 2:3 for prints, 9:16 for phone wallpapers, 16:9 for desktops. State the ratio clearly at the end of the prompt.

title: Neon Night City Portrait
description: A close portrait lit by coloured shop signs on a night street, with teal on one side of the face and warm orange on the other. The strong colour contrast gives a stylish, urban look without relying on a glowing sci-fi look.
promptText: Cinematic night portrait of a man in his thirties with a short beard, standing on a busy city street at night, looking directly at the camera with a calm, serious expression. Teal neon sign light on the left side of his face, warm orange shop light on the right, both soft and realistic, deep shadows between them. Blurred pedestrians and signs in the background with round bokeh. Dark bomber jacket over a grey hoodie. 50mm lens, aperture f/1.4, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, controlled colour, slight film grain. Horizontal 16:9 composition, head and shoulders, subject centred with space on both sides.
imageAlt: Bearded man at night lit by teal and orange shop signs with blurred city lights behind
visualNotes: Teal and orange sit on opposite sides of the colour wheel, so placing them on opposite sides of the face gives instant separation and depth. Keeping both sources 'soft and realistic' prevents the over-saturated, glowing look that quickly feels artificial.

customize.lighting: Swap teal and orange for magenta and amber, or use one coloured source only with a neutral fill for a calmer image.
customize.camera: A 35mm lens shows more street energy; an 85mm lens isolates the face more strongly from the background.
customize.background: A night market, a station entrance or a diner window each add distinct colour shapes. Avoid readable text on signs.
customize.wardrobe: A reflective rain jacket picks up the coloured lights in interesting ways; matte fabrics keep the focus on the face.
customize.mood: Replace 'calm, serious' with 'smirking, half turned' for a more playful, character-driven frame.
customize.composition: For a vertical version, request '4:5, head and shoulders, subject slightly right' and fewer background signs.
customize.aspectRatio: 16:9 suits banners and video thumbnails. For feeds, switch to 4:5 and tighten the framing.

title: Vintage Cinema Still Portrait
description: A portrait that borrows the glamour of mid-century studio films: soft diffused light, deep contrast and a composed, theatrical pose. It works for retro-themed posts, invitations and character art.
promptText: Vintage cinema still of a woman in her thirties with sculpted pin-curl hair and bold red lipstick, wearing a satin evening gown with a fur-trimmed stole, posed in a three-quarter turn with her chin lifted and a poised, knowing look. Soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle halo glow, a sharp key light from above and to the left, dark velvet curtain background. Rich contrast, silky skin, slight vignette, subtle film grain, gently faded colour palette with deep reds and warm neutrals. 85mm lens, aperture f/4. Vertical 4:5 composition, bust-length portrait, subject centred.
imageAlt: Woman in satin gown with pin-curl hair in a vintage cinema style portrait
visualNotes: The glamour look relies on a sharp key light for shape and a diffused halo to smooth highlights. A dark backdrop and a slight vignette pull attention to the face, mimicking the controlled lighting of old studio sets.

customize.lighting: Ask for 'butterfly lighting, a small shadow under the nose' for classic glamour, or 'split lighting' for a darker, noir feel.
customize.camera: A 105mm lens fits tighter beauty portraits; a 50mm lens includes more costume and set detail.
customize.background: A painted backdrop, a marble staircase or a draped silk curtain suit different eras. Keep tones dark and warm.
customize.wardrobe: A tuxedo jacket and bow tie would turn this into a gentleman's portrait; describe fabrics like velvet or satin for richer textures.
customize.mood: Change 'knowing look' to 'distant, dreamy gaze' for a softer romantic still.
customize.composition: For full-length costume shots ask for 'full-length, standing at the foot of a staircase' and move the subject off-centre.
customize.aspectRatio: 4:5 for posts; 2:3 for poster-style prints. Add 'film poster margins' if you want a border.
